scope: Actual dedicated model-connection credential replacement, validation/enable and one new Vercel/Pi 1.5.2 task using the previously authorized model account. No upstream account key rotation/revocation and no shared connection changes.
scenario: New private test connection created with inert placeholder credential, never validated upstream; replaced with existing authorized credential, revalidated and explicitly enabled before new Session.
limitations: Not upstream key issuance or revocation.
No promise of automatic master encryption-key rotation.
Old-Session/grant behavior is separately source/contract reviewed; this exercise tests a new Session after replacement.
